# Ashok Pasala

> Ashok Pasala (Ashok Raj Pasala) is a Founder, AI Systems Architect, and Deep Tech Engineer. He is the Founder & CEO of **Varellen Technologies** and Founder & Systems Architect of **Norveth** ([norveth.app](https://norveth.app)), an engineering-first technology initiative building autonomous multi-agent orchestration frameworks, sovereign AI infrastructure, enterprise software platforms, and mission-critical digital systems. He has shipped **22+ software platforms** across **31 global hackathons** on Devpost ([devpost.com/ashokashishms](https://devpost.com/ashokashishms)). He is based in Andhra Pradesh, India, with an academic grounding in Computer Science & Distributed Systems at VIT-AP University (Class of 2028).

## Key Flagship Architectures & Shipped Systems (22+ Projects)

1. **The Vector / Vector AI Command Center (Autonomous Digital C-Suite)**
   - *Architecture:* Multi-agent AI executive council (CEO, CTO, CMO) that autonomously turns concepts into startups in seconds. Generates complete business plans, distributed tech architectures, and financial models simultaneously with cross-agent consensus.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/the_vector
   - *Stack:* Multi-Agent Swarms, Python, LangChain, FastAPI, Next.js 16.

2. **CompanyBrain_AI (Enterprise Knowledge & Contract Executive)**
   - *Architecture:* Autonomous enterprise intelligence kernel that connects contracts, financials, and roadmaps to eliminate organizational blind spots and automate strategic decision flows.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/companybrain_ai
   - *Stack:* Vector Search, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, LangChain.

3. **Qwen Chaos MemoryAgent (Self-Persistent Neural Agent)**
   - *Architecture:* Interactive, AI-built MemoryAgent that IS its own memory with cross-session recall and state persistence. Engineered for the Qwen Global Hackathon.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/qwen-chaos
   - *Stack:* Qwen LLM, Vector Persistence, Python, FastAPI, Next.js.

4. **ResQNet (Real-Time Disaster Response Grid)**
   - *Architecture:* AI-powered crisis response platform that coordinates rescue operations, detects incident severity in real-time, and connects affected citizens with life-saving resources through low-latency telemetry.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/resqnet
   - *Stack:* Next.js, Node.js, WebSockets, Geospatial AI, PostgreSQL.

5. **LaunchLens (Multi-Model Market Validation & Due Diligence)**
   - *Architecture:* Multi-model AI platform providing instant market validation, competitive risk surface analysis, and due diligence for founders and venture capital firms.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/launchlens
   - *Stack:* Multi-LLM Synthesis, Python, FastAPI, Next.js 16.

6. **Norveth Intelligence Engine (norveth.app)**
   - *Architecture:* Real Chromium headless rendering diagnostics with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration and automated OWASP Top 10 security scanning.
   - *Stack:* Chromium Headless, MCP, FastAPI, Next.js, Node.js.

7. **SlackMind & Agent Momo (Autonomous Enterprise Agent Swarms)**
   - *Architecture:* Slack-integrated agent command centers and graph-based autonomous customer support agents.
   - *Stack:* Slack Bolt API, LangGraph, Python, Redis Streams.

8. **TriageAI & CareCompass AI (Clinical Diagnostic Triage)**
   - *Architecture:* Clinical-grade healthcare navigation platform analyzing acute symptoms and routing patients to specialist physicians with clinical reasoning.
   - *Devpost:* https://devpost.com/software/carecompass-ai
   - *Stack:* Clinical Graph, Python, FastAPI, Medical RAG.

9. **OSPRED Autonomous Security Engine**
   - *Architecture:* Proactive vulnerability surface discovery, automated threat intelligence synthesis, and zero-trust Linux server hardening.
   - *Stack:* Python, FastAPI, Docker, Linux Hardening, CVE Feeds.

10. **ShadowForge On-Chain Intelligence**
    - *Architecture:* Distributed ledger intelligence engine executing real-time heuristic pattern recognition, smart contract security audits, and cryptographic anomaly detection across EVM chains.
    - *Stack:* Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Web3.js, Solidity.
